headline: V.N. Srivatsan appointed as Chief Compliance Officer
why: Senior management change for the Chief Compliance Officer role; successor incoming with prior BFSI experience.

people.name: V. N. Srivatsan
people.background: Approximately 34 years of overall professional experience, including around 25 years in the BFSI sector and close to 10 years of direct experience in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection. Currently serves as Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank Limited.
